response.answer: null or {kind, value}; kind must match question.answer_type

evidence.source_value: JSON value at pointer; JSON decimal values are represented as canonical decimal strings

scope_checks.complete_scan: boolean assertion; only assert true after applying the public selection policy to the complete exported scope
scope_checks.resource_type: FHIR resource type or pipe-separated set declared by the selection policy
scope_checks.patient_reference: question.parameters.patient when patient-scoped; * for a corpus-wide scope
scope_checks.criteria: exactly the criteria keys and bindings declared by the matching public selection policy scope_template; scope is required or forbidden exactly as that template declares
scope_checks.scope_template: selection-policies.json declares required, resource_type, patient_reference, cutoff, and exact criteria bindings per policy

answer_value_shapes.code: recorded coding or declared mapping result
answer_value_shapes.quantity: {value: decimal string, unit: string}; unit is exact
answer_value_shapes.timestamp: date-only YYYY-MM-DD or ISO-8601 timezone-aware instant
answer_value_shapes.series: ordered array of {time: timezone-aware instant, value: decimal string, unit: string}

grading.numeric_quantities: compare decimal values numerically; units remain exact
grading.instants: compare timezone-aware instants semantically; date-only values are not instants
grading.series: order is significant and follows the matching public selection policy
grading.evidence: each decisive obligation needs exact or parent citation, or sufficient source leaves for an object-valued obligation
